---
title: Making figures using leader line
---

Some css and js has been added. See the css folder. To make a figure, proceed as follows. First you create a stage. 


```
#| eval: false # Do evaluate this chunk
</script>
<div class="stage" id="stage" style="position: relative; height: 300px;">

  <!-- <div class="tbox"  id="nodeA" >
  <div class="handwrith" id="nodeAh" style="">Manifold</div>
  <div class="handwrit" id="nodeAc" style="">Topological space locally $R^n$ covered by a family of </div>
  </div> -->

  <div class="bbcbox"  id="nodeA" >
  <div class="bbcheader" id="nodeA4" style="">Manifold</div>
  <div class="bbcbody" id="nodeA4" style="">Topological space locally $R^n$ covered by a family of

  <div class="tbox"  id="nodeA2" style="top: 20%; left: 70%;">
  <div class="theaderfill" id="nodeA2h" style="">Manifold</div>
  <div class="tbody" id="nodeA2c" style="">Topological space locally $R^n$</div>
  </div>

  <div class="anchor80-line" id="nodeC" style="width: 30%; position: absolute; top: 80%; left: 100px;">
    bb
  </div>
</div>
```

See the `css/shapes.css` file for details. `bbcbox` is a style I've seen on BBC News. Those shapes can be modified. 

But once you have the `stage`, you can create the connections.

```
<script>
  drawLeader({
    containerId: 'stage',
    from: {id: 'nodeA'},
    to: {id: 'nodeA2'},
    lineOptions: {color: 'DarkGoldenRod', endLabel: 'T(x)',path: 'fluid', startPlug: 'disc', endPlug: 'arrow3'}
  });

  drawLeader({
    containerId: 'stage',
    from: {id: 'nodeA'},
    to: {id: 'nodeC'},
    lineOptions: {color: 'navy', endLabel: 'T(x)',path: 'fluid', startPlug: 'disc', endPlug: 'arrow3'}
  });
</script>
```
